APEDA & International Testing Methodologies

Average Grain Length (AGL)

Measured using digital photographic calipers across 100 whole uncooked grains to guarantee minimum variety thresholds (e.g. 8.35mm for 1121 Basmati).

Digital Moisture Analysis

Moisture measured with calibrated Kett Riceter moisture meters. Controlled strictly between 11.5% and 12.5% to ensure safety against fungal contamination during 30-day ocean voyages.

Cooking Elongation Test

Sample batch is boiled in water bath under standardized conditions. Length measured before and after cooking to guarantee elongation ratio of 2.0x to 2.5x with non-sticky grains.

DNA Basmati Purity Test

Certified PCR laboratory testing verifying over 95% genetic purity of Basmati lines, guaranteeing zero adulteration with non-basmati lookalikes for EU and North American customs.
